items.source: Do not attempt to map fields against the model and treat the entire pipeline as-is.
items.translation: 请勿尝试将字段映射到模型，而是将整个管道原样处理。

items.source: Fields that do not exist in the model are treated as-is.
items.translation: 模型中不存在的字段将原样处理。

items.source: Mapping throws errors for non-existent, but referenced fields.
items.translation: 映射会对不存在但被引用的字段抛出错误。
